name: Sankey Diagram
summary: Flow widths proportional to value across stages — P&L walk from segment revenue to net income, revenue by segment to region, sources & uses.
summary_zh: 按数值比例绘制各阶段之间的流量宽度：从分部收入到净利润的损益流向、分部→地区收入、资金来源与用途。
description_zh: 每行数据是一条连线（source → target，value 为流量），节点总量、所在阶段（列）和标签位置由组件自动推导。最典型的用法是损益表桑基图：左侧为各业务分部收入，汇入总收入后逐级分流为毛利 / 销货成本、EBITDA / 运营费用、EBIT / 折旧摊销，直至净利润；成本节点（costNodes）以负向色显示，percentOf 可在标签上标注占收入的比例（即利润率）。线宽读数量、节点高度读总量；悬停高亮相邻流向，点击节点保持聚焦并交叉筛选。适合 3–6 个阶段、不超过约 30 个节点的结构化流向。
best_for: P&L walk: segment revenue → revenue → gross profit → EBITDA → net income
Revenue by segment → region / customer group
Customer or volume migration between stages
avoid_when: More than ~30 nodes or 6+ stages — aggregate first
Exact comparison of many similar values (use a bar or waterfall)

value.desc: Flow size (duplicate source → target rows are summed)

nodeAlign.desc: Column placement of sinks: left (P&L — costs branch off where they occur) | right | justify (all sinks in the last column)

nodeOrder.desc: data: keep row order within a column (cost nodes placed below profit lines) | auto: ECharts relaxation to minimise crossings

colorBy.desc: stage: ordinal ramp by column (dark → light) | node: categorical colour per node

nodeColors.desc: {nodeName: colour} — a theme token ('accent2', 'neg', 'cat3' …) or CSS colour

costNodes.desc: Node names drawn as costs / leakage in the theme's negative colour

highlight.desc: Node name(s) drawn in accent2 (e.g. 'Net income')

linkColor.desc: Link colour: source | target | gradient | neutral

linkOpacity.desc: Resting link opacity (hover / selection raise it)

nodeGap.desc: Gap between nodes in a column in px

labels.desc: Show node labels (first column outside-left, others to the right with a paper halo)

labelValues.desc: Formatted node total under each name

percentOf.desc: null | 'max' | node name — append '% of' that node to labels (e.g. margins vs. 'Revenue')

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field's format

crossFilter.desc: Click a node to select it (keeps its links in focus and filters other blocks)

filterScope.desc: dataset: the selection only filters blocks bound to the same dataset (field names like 'source' are generic) | global

interactions: Hover a node or link: adjacency emphasis + tooltip with inflow / outflow / % shares
Click a node to keep its flows in focus and cross-filter (click again to clear)

samples.title: FY25A P&L flow — segment revenue to net income (USD m)
Revenue build to gross profit — categorical nodes, links by source

options.where: target in ["Revenue", "Gross profit", "Cost of goods sold"]
